outlet: Statesman-Examiner (Colville), 2026-01-28, 'New Superior Court Judge Sworn In' (Tamara Lee Titus)
notes: Webster was sworn in on Jan. 23, 2026 as the governor's appointee to the Stevens, Pend Oreille and Ferry Superior Court after Judge Jessica Taylor Reeves retired on Dec. 31; 25 years in practice (criminal defense, family law, personal injury), Webster Law Office in Colville from 2009.
